# Caller guidance: ollama

This page is for whoever briefs ollama. The model does not read it.

## Use

- Send `local/ollama.wrapper.txt` with the task in its task slot. The model reads that file and never this page.
- Send `think=false` with the request. It is a setting of the call, not part of the prompt.

## Briefing guidance

### Limits

- Thinking: off. (`lessons:a-local-thinking-model-spends-hundreds-of-tokens-on-one-sentence`)

### Do

- Send exactly the num_ctx the model is loaded with. (`lessons:any-num_ctx-other-than-the-loaded-one-reloads-the-model-2026-10-07-evening`)
- Treat its output as a draft and apply only field values a reviewer checked. (`lessons:a-local-models-triage-is-a-draft-2026-10-07-evening`)
- Let code do the grouping and the counting, and let the model write prose only. (`lessons:code-does-the-grouping-and-the-counting-the-model-writes-prose-2026-10-07`)

### Do not

- Take its verdicts as facts, since it asserted false-positive verdicts it could not verify. (`lessons:a-local-models-triage-is-a-draft-2026-10-07-evening`)
